options.text: The magnets attract or repel in the same way for every pole pair.
Nothing happens because only matching paint colours on the ends decide the force.

stem:
Nidhi holds the north end of one bar magnet near the south end of another bar magnet.

What should she expect?

teacher.key_rationale: Unlike poles (N near S) attract. Saying they repel reverses the rule; treating every pole pair the same omits the like/unlike condition; paint colour alone does not decide the force.
